610:t_2:60.en:
$$ランド$$
「That guy's presence is like a typhoon that stirs up whatever place he's in.」

610:t_2:61.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I knew harm would reach you all too. But...」

610:t_2:62.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's not say any more about it.」

610:t_2:64.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't know how $$アサキム$$'s presence will play out...」

610:t_2:65.en:
$$ランド$$
「But I feel like I have to settle things with him too... settle them for real, in the true sense.」

610:t_2:66.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You're still so positive, as always.」

610:t_2:68.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「And you're just as hot-blooded as ever.」

610:t_2:70.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Glad to see you're doing well, $$マルグリット$$.」

610:t_2:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, getting worked to the bone at the Chief's place... you had some bad luck too.」

610:t_2:73.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「My $$パールネイル$$ is also a crystallization of $$インサラウム$$'s dimensional science.」

610:t_2:74.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「I'm sure the late Prince would approve of my putting that power to use in the Doctor's research.」

610:t_2:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. It may be just my own guess, but I think so too.」

610:t_2:76.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Come to think of it, $$マルグリット$$... when we parted during the $$再世戦争$$, you said you had something to tell me the next time we met...」

610:t_2:78.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Now... would not be fair...」

610:t_2:80.en:
$$トライア$$
「Right. This is hardly the time for that.」

610:t_2:82.en:
$$トライア$$
「I know... I'll let you see $$エスター$$.」

610:t_2:89.en:
$n
「...So you had the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ transferred over here during the battle...」

610:t_2:90.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This $$ソーラリアン$$ exists to run the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ operating system and to carry it to the site, after all.」

610:t_2:91.en:
$n
「Did you leave $c to get this ship finished?」

610:t_2:92.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize for keeping so much secret. But the existence of this $$ソーラリアン$$, above all, could not be allowed to come to the Empire's notice.」

610:t_2:93.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Because this ship and the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ are our trump card in the fight against $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_2:94.en:
$n
「$$Ｚクリスタル$$... Control over events, huh...」

610:t_2:95.en:
$n
「Did you go out of your way to have Miss $$スズネ$$ step out just to show me this?」

610:t_2:97.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「More to the point, for the talk to come... I doubt $n would want Miss $$スズネ$$ to hear it, either.」

610:t_2:99.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In the battle at $$インダストリアル７$$... you used the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$... of the $$スフィア$$, did you not?」

610:t_2:101.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$... That is the existence at the core of the twelve $$スフィア$$s.」

610:t_2:103.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to the information I have, the $$スフィア$$ was originally one, and for some reason it was divided into twelve pieces.」

610:t_2:104.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Each $$スフィア$$ governs a human emotion, but among them, the $$いがみ合う双子$$ has the role of integrating and controlling those powers.」

610:t_2:105.en:
$n
「Why would there be a power like that...?」

610:t_2:107.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But precisely because $$サイデリアル$$ knows this too, I believe they have been giving $n special treatment.」

610:t_2:108.en:
$n
「So they mean to use me for their own purposes...」

610:t_2:109.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $n... Even if all twelve $$スフィア$$s are gathered, you must never try to use that power.」

610:t_2:111.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe Miss $$スズネ$$'s case was triggered when the owners of each of the twelve $$スフィア$$s denied her death, and their power activated.」

610:t_2:112.en:
$n
「Setting $$クロウ$$ and the others aside, the Empire's Reactors, and even that $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$?」

610:t_2:113.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is only my conjecture, but I believe they denied not Miss $$スズネ$$'s death itself, but the one who caused it.」

610:t_2:115.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The wills of all the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s momentarily coincided, and that is how the miracle of that time came about.」

610:t_2:116.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, if a single human tried to control events like that, nothing awaits them but tragedy.」

610:t_2:118.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Most likely, you would no longer be able to exist as a human.」

610:t_2:120.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please look at the back of the case holding this $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

610:t_2:123.en:
$$トライア$$
「...That girl is $$エスター$$.」

610:t_2:125.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$エスター$$... What on earth happened to make her like this...」

610:t_2:126.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「$$ヴァイオレイション$$... It's the effect of being turned into a $$次元獣$$.」

610:t_2:128.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Through the power of the $$スフィア$$s of $$クロウ$$ and Prince $$ユーサー$$ she was able to return to being human, but even so, the effects of the 《$$リヴァイヴ・セル$$》 remained...」

610:t_2:129.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Right now, $$エスター$$ is something like an ultra-compact $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

610:t_2:131.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$ has fused completely with her biological functions, and controls $$次元力$$ much as a body turns food into energy to move.」

610:t_2:132.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$エスター$$, having become a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, can draw the surrounding $$次元力$$ into herself and control it by her own will.」

610:t_2:133.en:
$$トライア$$
「But since the $$新世時空震動$$, the amount of $$次元力$$ the Earth draws out has grown beyond all comparison with the $$再世戦争$$.」

610:t_2:134.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Had she taken all that in unawares, just as it was, her body and mind would have collapsed completely.」

610:t_2:135.en:
$$トライア$$
「Right now $$エスター$$ is in a state of suspended animation to protect herself from that torrent of $$次元力$$.」

610:t_2:136.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I understand why she's in a coma. Then why is $$エスター$$ in a place like this?」

610:t_2:138.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. $$エスター$$ serves as the converter that controls the $$次元力$$ drawn out by the $$Ｚクリスタル$$.」

610:t_2:140.en:
$$トライア$$
「You can call me a fiend, a devil, I don't mind...」

610:t_2:141.en:
$$トライア$$
「At first I kept up my research to save $$エスター$$, but when it hit a wall, I thought of using her to solve the stalled problem of controlling $$次元力$$...」

610:t_2:142.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...You're still continuing the research to save $$エスター$$, aren't you?」
